note: Keyed by recipe. A measurement is shown ONLY on the recipe it was taken on — the first version attached one chest X-ray result to every dual-arm recipe, which stated something no measurement supported for CIFAR-10.

PNEUMONIA_CNN.headline: Full fine-tuning buys +0.0224 AUC for 3,321x the communication. Defensible in a datacenter, not on a phone.

measured_on.protocol: 400 rounds, 3 seeds, alpha=1.0, 20 clients, 10/round, 3 local epochs

FULL.summary: Higher accuracy. Needs a datacenter — a single on-device step costs 44.8 s, so a federated round is not feasible on a phone.

FROZEN_HEAD.summary: 3,321x less communication and the only arm that runs on-device (0.1115 ms/step). Costs 0.0224 AUC against a full fine-tune.

PNEUMONIA_CNN.ondevice_ratio_basis: LiteRT Flex on both arms (the record's like-for-like comparison)
caveats: One task (chest X-ray), one alpha (1.0), one architecture family, three seeds per cell.
The communication ratio is ROUND-BUDGET DEPENDENT: it grows with the number of rounds because the frozen arm's one-shot backbone delivery is amortised over them. Quoted at 400 rounds.
Accuracy and on-device latency were measured on DIFFERENT hardware (RTX 4060 and an SDM845 handset). The joint claim composes two measurements; no single cell measures both.
No differential privacy evaluated. DP noise scales with parameter count and should favour the frozen arm further, but that is an expectation, not a measurement.

CNN.headline: On this recipe the frozen arm reaches 10.0% — chance level for ten classes. A full fine-tune reaches 38.0%.

measured_on.backbone: CnnNet, randomly initialised (identical for both arms)
measured_on.protocol: 3 rounds, 2 clients, seed 0, live federation on the product path

FULL.summary: Reaches 38.0% and is still improving at round 3. The only arm that learns on this recipe.

FROZEN_HEAD.summary: Reaches 10.0%, which is chance for ten classes. This recipe's backbone is randomly initialised, so freezing it trains a head on random features. Pick a pretrained recipe if you want a frozen backbone.

caveats: Chance for ten classes is 10.0%; the frozen arm is AT it, so its accuracy carries no signal rather than being merely low.
Only 3 rounds with 2 clients and one seed — the FULL arm had not converged and its number is a floor, not a ceiling.
Communication and on-device cost were not measured for this recipe.
This is CIFAR-10 with a small custom CNN; it says nothing about other tasks.
